title: Divergence Hypothesis Harness for Embedding+Reranker Config Changes
creator: Sophie Chen
description: Build a configurable offline evaluation harness that codifies divergence hypotheses for embedding and reranker changes. The goal is to provide fast, reproducible checks (precision/recall, MRR, AUC where applicable) and cohort-level drift signals tied to config or model updates, enable automated gate recommendations for canary rollouts, and emit summarized evidence to the Console and alerting pipeline.
acceptance_criteria: A reproducible offline job that computes precision@k and recall@k and MRR across configurable cohorts within 6 hours for the production replay sample
Divergence detector that compares baseline vs candidate changes and emits a delta score plus statistical significance estimate
Automatic generation of a canary decision artifact (pass/warn/fail) based on configurable thresholds that the rollout engine can consume
Cohort-level drift views surfaced in Console (or via dashboard link) with anchor examples and top-5 failure cases
Integration tests and a smoke script that validates end-to-end signal propagation to alerting and rollback hooks
steps: Design: define divergence hypotheses (global and cohort-level) and metric math; align with PM and Product Quality
Data: implement replay sampled extractor that preserves user/session slices and labels for reranker evaluation
Compute: implement offline evaluator job with batching, caching of embeddings, and delta statistics
Detector: add cohort-aware drift detector using bootstrap/approx tests and effect-size heuristics
Integration: event generation to Console + alerting; expose canary decision JSON to rollout service
QA: run multi-candidate experiments vs historical releases and document false-positive rate
comments: 2026-03-10 Sophie Chen: Kickoff — collected requirements from PM (Aisha) and Product Quality. Initial divergence taxonomy agreed (regression, distribution-shift, ranking-erosion).
2026-03-11 Marco Linde: Prototype offline replay extractor and validated it reproduces historical metrics for last two releases. Saved sample to s3://redwood-evals/ENG-88214/sample-v1.tar.gz
2026-03-12 Design review (Aisha Patel): requested anchor-example UI and per-cohort explanation snippets; agreed to include top-5 counterexamples for each failing cohort.
2026-03-12 Marco Linde: Opened PR with evaluator code and detector: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/1482 — next: add canary artifact generator and tests.
2026-03-13 QA note (Jamal Rivera): observed a false-positive signal when sample size < 250 for niche cohorts; added a minimum-sample threshold and effect-size gating.
notes: Trade-offs: running full replay on every config change is expensive. Strategy: sample-based fast path + full-run nightly snapshot for borderline cases.
Rollout flow: evaluator writes decision json to rollout-store; rollout-controller reads decision and either allows canary, flags for manual review, or triggers automatic rollback depending on policy.
Future: extend to embedding-quantization changes and include token-length conditioned cohorts.
